rows.en: Fain: "That's Zaxas!
Why is Master's mech...?"
Cain: "This is the first time we've met face-to-face, isn't it?"
Celica: "That voice... Could it be Cain?!"
Cain: "Hello, Celica. It's been a while.
Is Tix well?"
Celica: "Why are you in Zaxas...?"
Cain: "Well, why indeed?
You'll find out eventually. Eventually.
Oh, and there's no point protesting to my country.
Officially, I no longer exist."
Celica: "What do you mean...?"
Cain: "I suppose you could call me a tragic prince driven from his country."
Celica: "Stop fooling around!"
Cain: "...That's enough talk.
I have to fight you for my own sake.
Now... Here I come!"
Miyasco: "It can't be... No, that's impossible.
Survivors, even now...? But that... Remote control..."
Sisk: "What's wrong? You're white as a sheet."
Miyasco: "I-I'm all right..."
Ai: "Touya, I'm going to do things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll act
on my own."
Clovis: "I'll operate alone. I'm leaving your side to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I can't put my life in your hands yet.
I'll do things my way."
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following your orders.
I'll act as I see fit."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice still doesn't
dwell within you! I cannot follow the orders of such a person!
So I shall follow my own justice! That is all!"
Maki: "A-All right, this is my chance! I'll get this battle... Wait,
why isn't it Rayblade?!
Oh, well. I'll record it for now... Reisuke!"
Reisuke: "Beep-beep-beep... Bzzzz."
Celica: "Cain! Is it really you?!"
Cain: "Yes. Have I changed that much?"
Celica: "I'm not talking about how you look.
The Cain I know would never do this.
Who are you?!"
Cain: "I'm me. For Rayfon, you picked a valuable
research sample, an Azera flower,
and got scolded. I'm the same Cain who knows about that."
Celica: "Is it really... Cain...?"
Cain: "That's what I've been telling you.
Now, this is no time for old stories.
We're in the middle of a battle."
Celica: "Cain..."
Fain: "How do you know about Master?!"
Vales: "Heh..."
Fain: "Could you be...?"
Vales: "I'm nobody. Just a mercenary captivated by battle.
Nothing more, nothing less..."
Fain: "What?! Those moves... Master...?"
Vales: "Oh, so you're the man who's Rest's pupil...
Heh heh heh. You move quite well..."
Fain: "You... No, you are..."
Vales: "What's wrong? Show me what you can do.
Your master was better than that."
Vales: "Vel, how's the data collection?"
Vel: "Perfect. We've finished tampering with the facility, too."
Vales: "Good. Then it's about time we lent a hand."
Jono: "Understood."
Cain: "That mech..."
Vales: "You in the black Armored Mech. We'll be lending you a hand."
Cain: "...I see. So this is insurance...
Heh heh heh... Well, fine..."
Jono: "No response."
Vales: "I see. No matter. We've already achieved our objective.
We'll withdraw when the time is right. Don't push yourselves."
Vel: "Got it."
Jono: "Understood."
Cain: "...Not bad...
It looks like that's it for today...
But next time won't be like this..."
Vales: "That's enough for now. All right, withdraw!"
